mapper.select: SELECT question, generated_sql, feedback_text, rating, MATCH(question) AGAINST(#{question} IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) as relevance FROM rag_feedback WHERE rating <= 2 AND MATCH(question) AGAINST(#{question} IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) ORDER BY relevance DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT question, generated_sql, feedback_text, rating, 1.0 as relevance FROM rag_feedback WHERE question = #{question} AND rating <= 2 ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
